# iru_inventory (Data Source)

Lists ID/name metadata for a documented configuration object family. Useful for migration inventory and selecting import IDs. Never returns scripts, XML, enrollment codes, signed file URLs, device inventory or users. Reads every page with origin/endpoint validation and bounded pagination; results are sorted by UUID.

## Example Usage


```terraform
data "iru_inventory" "scripts" {
  kind = "custom_scripts"
}

data "iru_inventory" "categories" {
  kind = "self_service_categories"
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) blueprints, tags, custom_scripts, custom_apps, custom_profiles, in_house_apps, ade_integrations, or self_service_categories.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Selected inventory kind.
- `items` (Attributes List) Complete UUID/name projection sorted by UUID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Object UUID.
- `name` (String) Object display name; ADE uses server_name.

This lookup makes no mutations. Each result contains only a UUID and display name.
Self Service categories are list-only in the documented API and have no lifecycle resource.
